data.claim: The safest protocol elevates a crash-without-terminal-record to a Byzantine fault scenario, requiring a Byzantine-fault-tolerant consensus among independent storage witnesses that the workspace contains no completed evidence before reclamation.
data.qualification: Mechanism: treat workspace as potentially adversarial; reclamation proceeds only after BFT consensus among a quorum of storage nodes confirms no evidence-carrying object exists. Durably recorded: BFT-signed emptiness certificate.
